source_caption:
Matt Damon originally began writing the foundation of this script for a playwriting class at Harvard, initially conceiving it as a high-stakes thriller about a math prodigy outsmarting the government. It was legendary filmmaker Rob Reiner who famously advised Damon and Ben Affleck to completely scrap the espionage plot and focus entirely on the profound emotional bond between the troubled young man and his therapist, transforming a generic action concept into an Oscar-winning masterclass in human vulnerability.
⠀
Good Will Hunting (1997), directed by Gus Van Sant, starring Matt Damon, Robin Williams, Ben Affleck. A brilliant but rebellious working-class janitor at MIT must confront his deep-seated trauma with the help of an empathetic therapist to finally embrace his true potential.

source_details.title: Good Will Hunting
source_details.synopsis: Good Will Hunting is a 1997 American drama film directed by Gus Van Sant and written by Ben Affleck and Matt Damon. It stars Damon, Affleck, Robin Williams, Stellan Skarsgård, and Minnie Driver, with Casey Affleck and Cole Hauser in supporting roles. Set in Boston, the film follows Will Hunting (Damon), a troubled but self-taught genius working as a janitor at MIT, whose talent is discovered by professor Gerald Lambeau (Skarsgård). To avoid jail, Will agrees to study under Lambeau while attending therapy with psychologist Sean Maguire (Williams), which forces him to confront his past and his relationships, including with Harvard student Skylar (Driver).
